mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at overcast skies today at Fireman's Park, and please note the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has announced that chip sealing road treatments begin September 23. Work will occur on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and Liberty Business Park between 9 AM and 3 PM. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss several local development projects.

There is plenty happening in our area. Today, we have the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, live music at Bailey's Run, and events at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, and later this week we have trivia at Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's.
In a report covering late August through mid-September, officers noted an incident on September 3 where a 33-year-old man was arrested for an O W I after a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel. We look forward to their return, but in the meantime, please plan your dining accordingly.
